title: P2 delta-neutral basis/carry economics + P3 momentum replication, on untouched $0 Binance Vision data (descriptive, NOT a strategy)
author_lane: independent 4th agent (owner-directed continuation of STUDY-02); filed to manager for review
role: STUDY-02 concluded: perp-only taker funding-tilt is dead; the coherent P2 form is delta-neutral spot+perp (needs spot data, $0); the P3 alt-momentum positives were a regime artifact pending replication. This study measures both on a window NO prior round touched. Creates NO strategy, NO candidate, consumes NO PIVOT-01 attempt budget.

data_frozen.source: data.binance.vision free archives (CC BY-NC-SA research use), fetched with sha256 provenance per file into data/vision/ (new, unowned path)

conventions.close_availability: kline close is published at close_time = open_time + 60s (causal; never paired at open_time)
conventions.no_trade_minutes: klines with trade count 0 are MISSING (no forward-fill) - matches STUDY-02 and transform-v2 semantics
conventions.hour_close: last non-missing 1m close in the hour
conventions.funding: settlement rows (calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate); positive rate = longs pay shorts

data_frozen.missing_months: a 404/absent monthly zip is recorded as absent and that symbol-month is excluded (never imputed)

costs_frozen.primary_all_taker_vip0: spot 10 bps/side x2 + perp 5 bps/side x2 = 30 bps per book round trip (Binance VIP0 list prices)
costs_frozen.posthoc_bnb: spot 7.5 x2 + perp 4.5 x2 = 24 bps (BNB discount, labeled POST-HOC)

armA_method_frozen.basis: b_t = (perp_close - spot_close)/spot_close at minutes where both legs present
descriptive: basis mean/median/p10/p90 in bps; fraction positive; annualized mean premium = mean_b * 3 * 365
convergence signature: Pearson correlation between b_t and (b_{t+8h} - b_t) over common minutes (negative = mean-reverting premium)

signal_cells.trigger: at any minute t: basis_annualized(b_t) >= 8% (a priori hurdle = risk-free-equivalent + operational premium) -> enter SHORT perp + LONG spot at the NEXT common close (t+1 minute close, causal)
signal_cells.exit: first common minute close >= entry_close_time + H
signal_cells.pnl_exact: spot_ret + short_perp_ret where spot_ret = (spot_exit - spot_entry)/spot_entry and short_perp_ret = (perp_entry - perp_exit)/perp_entry
signal_cells.funding_attribution: settlements strictly inside (entry_ts, exit_ts): SHORT-perp collects +rate
signal_cells.one_position: per (symbol, hold): overlapping signals skipped and counted
signal_cells.warmup: none needed beyond data start; signals only inside window

armA_method_frozen.capital_efficiency_declared: total capital = notional*(1 + 1/L) for perp-leg leverage L in {1,2,3} (spot wallet cannot margin the futures leg on Binance - declared assumption); net_ann_on_total = ann_carry / (1 + 1/L)
armA_method_frozen.decision_rule: MERITS-CANDIDATE-EVALUATION iff median 168h-hold net >= 0 under 30bps AND net_ann_on_total at L=1 >= 8%; else NOT-WORTH-AT-RETAIL-SCALE (owner decision recorded, no capture justified)

armB_method_frozen.construction: identical to STUDY-02 P3 (prereg 3811afe): trailing-24h return >= +100bps -> LONG / <= -100bps -> SHORT at 1h closes; exits at 4h/8h/24h closes; one position per (symbol, side, horizon); funding attribution where settlements exist (absent funding zip -> funding=0, labeled); 26bps RT
armB_method_frozen.purpose: replication/robustness check of STUDY-02's alt-momentum finding on a window no round touched - NOT candidate creation
armB_method_frozen.decision_rule: REPLICATED iff >= 2 of {NEARUSDT, STRKUSDT, WUSDT} LONG 24h cells have net_mean > 0 with n_entered >= 15 in the new window; else NOT-REPLICATED (regime artifact confirmed). BTC/ETH cells reported for consistency (expected ~0/negative).

posthoc_sensitivity_declared: BNB-discount cost arm (24bps) for arm A; trigger 4%/12% for arm A; trigger 50/200bps for arm B - all labeled POST-HOC, never decision-relevant.
decision_rules_global: Whatever the outcome: NO candidate is created, NO strategy code changes, NO attempt-budget consumption
Outputs inform the owner's P2/P3 pursuit and the 10-day-capture decision with measured numbers
Live submission stays disabled; no credentials; no orders
non_goals: No worker-lane file touched (W1 strategies/research, W2 market_data/execution, W3 risk/accounting)
No claim of profitability; descriptive economics only
